# Synthetic PDC policy shape

`pdc_networks.json` is an invented minimized items/metadata/pagination envelope,
not a live population or measurement. Only one policy matches stack 123 and
`set:pdc-signing`. Foreign stack, org realm and unrelated scope exercise independent
attribution instead of trusting the server realm filter. Names, addresses, configuration,
token values and labels are absent. The test adds private sentinels transiently.

The frozen staff witness established one matching policy among 25, with nextPage null;
the Admin region-union control established complete empty control-realm pages, not
exact-None access to all regions. Continuation validation uses the existing
`gcom.fetch_access_policies` GCOM link contract and reconstructs the fixed stack proxy
request using only a cursor and unchanged filters. Unsupported forms remain unavailable.
The compose fixture's PDC field is generated offline with `--synthetic-pdc`, preserving
all pre-existing fields and formatting. No connection, token or usage evidence is claimed.
